answer: Ask what breaks first and it is the uptime clock. Balance unlocks only after thirty days of continuous attested uptime, and every gap resets the counter to zero. Reciprocity weights the attestations, since a juror's vote counts in proportion to how much it has itself been vouched for. One operator with eighty keys lost six to a power cut on day twenty-nine and all six counters went back to zero while the other seventy-four kept earning. The raven does not stay for free, the inlet closes on a gap, and a comet passes once while uptime returns.
